title: The role of knowledge management in achieving competitive advantage through strategic orientation: a field study of the Yemeni banking sector in Sana’a
core_idea: Investigate how knowledge management practices (generation, sharing, application, storage) interact with strategic orientation to support banks in achieving competitive advantage and to provide a framework for enhancing sector performance and long-term competitiveness.
tldr: A quantitative field study of Yemeni banks (random sample of 300) designed to test hypotheses about the role of knowledge management in achieving competitive advantage through strategic orientation.
